properties.description: Review public component properties through the regular engine-backed Node editor and contributor-owned component composition through the Repositories bush. Verify multiline editing, live preview changes, normalized values, component/type/source navigation and preserved selection. Distinguish repository containment from component composition. Check workspace and Review revision behavior; preview property values do not claim source persistence. The property editor is implemented, while end-to-end composition verification remains work for the preceding task. Corrections stay children of this review; only the user records acceptance.
properties.title: Review component properties and composition navigation
